newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 3.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Economy and Finance Minister N'Goran Niamien presents law to parliament reforming parastatal sector, giving powers to boards of directors to hire and fire director-generals, and increasing state supervision of procurement and accounting practices.
- Succesful bidder in Sodesucre privatisation to be announced on Wednesday. Bidders are Illovo Sugar of South Africa, SIFCA of Ivory Coast, Senegalese Mimran and London-based ED&F Man.
- The president of the parliamentary group of the ruling Democratic Party, Edjampan Thiemele, warns that inaction of authorities will only serve to fuel social tension.
